proposed_sites.reason: The mcp.server.fastmcp module path is removed in v2; this import must become 'from mcp.server.mcpserver import MCPServer' — both the module path (rule 1) and the class name (FastMCP -> MCPServer, rule 2) change.
Constructs an instance of FastMCP, the class that is renamed to MCPServer in v2 (rule 2). The identifier itself must be changed to MCPServer(...).
